# ASJ Roofing

This file provides information about the ASJ Roofing website for AI agents and LLMs. 

## About Us
ASJ Roofing is a premium roofing and loft conversion company serving Frome, Bath, Somerset, Wiltshire, Warminster, Shepton Mallet, Trowbridge, Wells, Glastonbury, Melksham, Devizes, Bradford on Avon, and Chippenham.

## Services
- New Roof Installations (Slate, Tile, Concrete)
- Roof Repairs (Leaks, Tile Damage, Chimneys, Leadwork)
- Flat Roofing (GRP Fiberglass, EPDM Rubber, Felt)
- Loft Conversions (Dormer, Velux, Structural Integration)
- 24/7 Emergency Repairs (Storm Damage, Rapid Response)

## Contact
- Phone: +44 7974 100989
- Email: contact@asj-roofing.co.uk
- Location: Frome, Somerset, BA11 5AS, United Kingdom

## Technical Details
This site is built with Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. All images are optimized in WebP format for fast delivery.
